title: COA affirms with finality disallowance notice vs OVP’s P73M secret funds
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has “affirmed with finality” the notice of disallowance it issued on the P73 million confidential funds of the Office of the Vice President (OVP).…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has “affirmed with finality” the notice of disallowance it issued on the P73 million confidential funds of the Office of the Vice President (OVP). In a resolution dated Oct. 5, the COA said it denied the OVP’s motion for reconsideration filed against COA’s Notice of Disallowance (ND)
